task: You are hungry! Let's cook a delicious meal. Check the cookbook in the kitchen for the recipe. Once done, enjoy your meal!
description:

You can make out a fridge. You can see an oven. You make out a table. You see a cookbook on the table. I mean, just wow! Isn't TextWorld just the best? You scan the room, seeing a counter.
